name: Introductory Guidance to AICM v1.1
description: Companion narrative guidance to the AI Controls Matrix v1.1. Explains the AICM's structure — the five pillars (control type, applicability and ownership, architectural relevance, lifecycle relevance, threat category), the AI shared responsibility model across Cloud Service Provider / Model Provider / Orchestrated Service Provider / Application Provider / AI Customer, and how to apply the matrix in an assessment. Includes a change-log summary of the differences from AICM v1.0.
relationToCloudSecurity: Explains how AICM layers onto cloud-platform controls covered by CCM, and how ownership is apportioned across the AI supply chain in a cloud context.
relationToAISecurity: The interpretive companion to the current AI controls catalog. Read alongside the AICM spreadsheet rather than in place of it.

license.notes: Document carries '© 2026 Cloud Security Alliance – All Rights Reserved' with CSA's standard download/store/display/print grant.

lifecycle.notes: Ships as a PDF inside the AICM v1.1 ZIP bundle. Release date taken from CSA's artifact page; see the AICM 1.1.0 metadata for the full reasoning on the four conflicting dates in the bundle.

current_extraction.notes: 56-page PDF with a clean text layer; no OCR forcing needed. Heading hierarchy, tables, and the change-log summary all survived. 112 page images extracted alongside the markdown.

notes: Describes AICM v1.1 specifically. Its control-ID examples follow v1.1 numbering, which differs from v1.0.3 — see control/cloudsecurityalliance.org/aicm/VERSIONING.md.

desired_end_state.notes: Narrative guidance with no regular per-item structure to extract into CSV/JSON. Markdown is the appropriate terminal form.
